title: MIDSEA Summer School 2025
text:
The MIDSEA Summer School returned in 2025, hosted by Universitas Gadjah Mada in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, from 23-29 June. Building on the success of the 2024 edition in Vietnam, this year’s programme offered parallel tracks covering both foundational and advanced disease modelling concepts, plus plenty of opportunities to network with modellers from across Southeast Asia and beyond.

title: MIDSEA Summer School 2025
text:
23 - 29 June 2025 · Yogyakarta, Indonesia, hosted by Universitas Gadjah Mada, following on from a successful 2024 event in Vietnam.

Parallel tracks addressing both foundational and advanced disease modelling concepts
Networking opportunities with modellers across Southeast Asia and beyond


What’s included

Seven days of sessions
Keynote speakers
Hands-on workshops
Networking meals
Open discussion forums
Coffee and tea breaks
Certificate of attendance

Fees vary by region and accommodation type. LMIC/HIC classifications follow the World Bank’s country classifications.


Scholarships
A limited number of scholarships are available. To be eligible, applicants must:

Be residents of an LMIC (as classified by the World Bank)
Self-fund their own travel
Commit to attending the full programme
Accept twin-share accommodation

Scholarship notifications go out by 14 April 2025.


How to register
Complete the registration form linked here by 2 April 2025. Early submission is encouraged as places are limited.
